acceptance_tests.material-accounting: Import, render, transport, transition and save every material and phase with an explicit property model and conserved inventory.
acceptance_tests.message-transaction: Exercise valid, invalid, blocked and batch requests in a disposable colony; custom fluid mutations and native nonfluid operations commit together exactly once.
acceptance_tests.native-service: Verify exact-platform native code/ABI, service routing, worker synchronization, buffer lifetime, shutdown and no second fluid owner in the actual game. Forwarding observer results alone cannot pass takeover.
acceptance_tests.snapshot-lifetime: Verify count/pointer consistency, completed-frame coherence, retained buffer lifetime, exactly-once callbacks and no publication on a rejected frame.
acceptance_tests.callsite-transaction: Trigger the originating gameplay action with available and blocked outputs; check inputs, work, heat, disease and callbacks against ledgers.
acceptance_tests.ownership: Run a disposable native-hook colony with authoritative custom mixtures, progressing native solids/buildings and correct callbacks; audit all native fluid readers/writers and trace suppression/replacement. Projected native fluid cells are allowed; zero-fluid scans and forwarding observers do not prove ownership.
acceptance_tests.transport: Bulk and selective transfers preserve traces, energy and disease; backpressure and blocked capacity consume no input or work.
acceptance_tests.conversion: Every recipe has balanced material, explicit work and heat, depletion behavior and atomic blocked-output rejection.
acceptance_tests.biology: Respiration, photosynthesis, metabolism and excretion debit and credit actual inventories across their full life cycle.
acceptance_tests.environment: Environmental sources, destruction and phase changes conserve material and energy with explicit external ledgers.
acceptance_tests.geometry: Fluid volume and interface geometry drive flooding, swimming, pressure damage, displacement and access without duplicate inventories.
acceptance_tests.persistence: Same-frame native/custom atomic save, reload, deterministic continuation, failure recovery and safe mod-disabled rejection.
